description: Learn Bootstrap 5 core components: buttons, button groups, badges, cards, dismissible alerts, list groups, spinners, and progress bars.

slides.title: Basic Components Overview
slides.content:
# Bootstrap 5 Core Components 🧱

Bootstrap is famous for its battle-tested, accessible component primitives. In this module, you will master the foundational UI components that appear in virtually every web app:

- **Buttons & Button Groups** (`.btn`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-group`)
- **Badges & Pills** (`.badge`, `.rounded-pill`)
- **Cards** (`.card`, `.card-body`, `.card-img-top`)
- **Alerts** (`.alert`, `.alert-dismissible`)
- **List Groups** (`.list-group`, `.list-group-item`)
- **Spinners & Loaders** (`.spinner-border`, `.spinner-grow`)
- **Progress Bars** (`.progress`, `.progress-bar`)
- **Breadcrumbs** (`.breadcrumb`)

slides.title: Buttons: Variants & Styles
slides.content:
# Buttons: Core Classes & Color Variants 🔘

Every button starts with the base `.btn` class, followed by a color theme variant.

```html_not
<button type="button" class="btn btn-primary">Primary</button>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary">Secondary</button>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-success">Success</button>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-danger">Danger</button>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-warning">Warning</button>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-info text-white">Info</button>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-dark">Dark</button>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-link">Link Style</button>
```

## Outline Buttons (`.btn-outline-*`)

When you want a lighter secondary button that fills on hover:

```html_not
<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary">Outline Primary</button>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-danger">Delete</button>
```

slides.title: Cards: The Modern Container
slides.content:
# Cards: The Swiss Army Knife Container 🃏

Bootstrap Cards replace panels, wells, and thumbnails from older versions.

## Card Anatomical Parts

- `.card`: The main bordered wrapper with rounded corners
- `.card-body`: Padded content area
- `.card-title`: Heading title inside body
- `.card-subtitle`: Subtitle with muted color
- `.card-text`: Body paragraph text
- `.card-header` & `.card-footer`: Optional framing bands
- `.card-img-top` / `.card-img-bottom`: Images that conform to the card's top/bottom rounded radius

slides.title: Alerts & Dismissible Alerts
slides.content:

``` > ⚡ **JavaScript Integration:** Adding `data-bs-dismiss="alert"` and `.btn-close` wires up dismiss animation automatically with zero custom JS code!

slides.title: Card Groups & Card Grids
slides.content:
# Card Layouts: Groups vs Grids 🗂️ ## Card Groups (`.card-group`) Renders cards as a single, attached horizontal block with equal height: ```html_not
Card 1
Card 2
Card 3
``` ## Recommended Modern Approach: Card Grid (`row-cols-*`) Pair cards with `.h-100` inside a `.row-cols-*` grid so cards in the same row always share identical heights!

slides.title: Common Pitfalls with Components
slides.content:
# Common Component Gotchas ⚠️

1. **Old Bootstrap 4 data attributes**: BS5 uses `data-bs-*` prefixes (e.g. `data-bs-dismiss="alert"`, NOT `data-dismiss="alert"`).
2. **Missing `.btn` base class**: Writing `<button class="btn-primary">` without `.btn` breaks padding, borders, and animations.
3. **Missing `.visually-hidden` for screen readers**: Notification badges like `99+` must include screen reader descriptions.

slides.title: Summary: Basic Components
slides.content:
# Basic Components: Summary 📋

## Key Takeaways
- **Buttons**: Base `.btn` + color variant (`.btn-primary`, `.btn-outline-*`) + `.btn-lg`/`.btn-sm`.
- **Badges**: Label with `.badge` and shape with `.rounded-pill`.
- **Cards**: Flexible box model with `.card-header`, `.card-body`, and `.card-footer`.
- **Alerts**: Contextual messages dismissible with `data-bs-dismiss="alert"`.
- **Spinners & Progress**: CSS-only indicators with `.spinner-border` and `.progress-bar`.

Next: Master interactive JavaScript components: Modals, Navbars, Carousels, and Accordions! 📱
